tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         SUM(Total) AS revenue
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY year
), ranked AS (
  SELECT y.*, 
         (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice i WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER)=y.year-1) AS prev_revenue,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk
  FROM yearly y
)
SELECT year, revenue, prev_revenue, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;
"}

{"sql":"WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         SUM(Total) AS revenue
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY year
), top AS (
  SELECT y.*, 
         (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice i WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS INTEGER)=y.year-1) AS prev_revenue
  FROM yearly y
  WHERE y.revenue = (SELECT MAX(revenue) FROM yearly)
)
SELECT year,
       revenue,
       prev_revenue,
       revenue - IFNULL(prev_revenue,0) AS abs_change,
       CASE WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (revenue - prev_revenue)/prev_revenue
       END AS pct_change,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yearly y2 WHERE y2.revenue = (SELECT MAX(revenue) FROM yearly)) AS top_count
FROM top;
"}

  WHERE y.revenue = (SELECT MAX(revenue) FROM yearly)
)
